paper.title_en: Thermodynamic Volumes of Extended Black Hole Thermodynamics with Auxiliary Gauge Fields
paper.abstract_en: By applying the Iyer-Wald formalism to the modified Lagrangian form for the gravitational system, where the coupling constants appearing in the original Lagrangian form, such as the cosmological constant, are promoted to the dynamical scalar fields by introducing the corresponding auxiliary gauge fields, we derive the first law of the extended black hole thermodynamics, where the resulting thermodynamic volumes as the conjugate thermodynamic variables to the coupling constants are nevertheless independent of the auxiliary gauge fields and exactly the same as those obtained before via varying the coupling constants by brute force. In addition, it is further shown that such volumes can also be expressed in terms of the auxiliary gauge fields and evaluated on the black hole horizon, validating the proposal made in the previous literature.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将 Iyer-Wald 形式应用于扩展黑洞热力学，推导出耦合常数共轭的热力学体积，属于黑洞热力学方向的理论工作，对关注该领域形式基础的研究者有阅读价值。
decision.title_zh: 带有辅助规范场的扩展黑洞热力学的热力学体积
decision.abstract_zh: 通过将 Iyer-Wald 形式应用于引力系统的修改拉格朗日量形式，其中原始拉格朗日量形式中出现的耦合常数（例如宇宙学常数）通过引入相应的辅助规范场被提升为动力学标量场，我们推导出扩展黑洞热力学的第一定律，其中作为耦合常数的共轭热力学变量的所得热力学体积却与辅助规范场无关，并且与之前通过强行改变耦合常数所得到的体积完全一致。此外，进一步表明这种体积也可以用辅助规范场表示，并在黑洞视界上进行计算，从而验证了先前文献中提出的方案。
